verdict.rationale: Braintrust supports exporting logs/traces via CLI (`bt sync pull`, download as CSV/JSON) and a full API for programmatic access to traces, datasets, and experiments, which developers could pipe into blob storage or a warehouse themselves. However, there is no documented native connector or bulk-export feature specifically targeting blob storage (S3/GCS) or data warehouses (Snowflake/BigQuery) — missing for 10: dedicated warehouse/blob-storage export integrations, scheduled/automated bulk export pipelines, and independent confirmation of large-scale export performance.
